idea-plugin.name: FineLock
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically refactors coarse-grained synchronized locks into fine-grained ReentrantReadWriteLock locks: read locks, write locks, splitting locks and downgrading locks.

Based on FineLock: Automatically Refactoring Coarse-Grained Locks into Fine-Grained Locks (Zhang, Shao, Zhai, Ma; ISSTA 2020). Use Refactor | Convert to Fine-Grained Locks (FineLock) on a file, package or the whole project, review the inferred locks and the diff, then apply.

action.description: Convert synchronized methods and blocks into ReentrantReadWriteLock read, write, splitting and downgrading locks
